definitions.explanation: Describes eyes whose outer corners extend long and slightly upward, giving a narrow, elegant shape. Usually a compliment, associated with a cool, refined look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{長|なが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だ。
examples.english: His long, narrow eyes are striking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧⟦{色白|いろじろ}→色白：32167_irojiro⟧で{切|き}れ{長|なが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The beauties of ukiyo-e prints are usually drawn with pale skin and long, narrow eyes.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always in {切|き}れ{長|なが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (long, narrow eyes). It praises the shape rather than describing small eyes, which is ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ or {細目|ほそめ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つり{目|め}→つり目：32967_tsurime⟧: upturned eyes (outer corners rising; can sound sharp or severe)
- ⟦{垂|た}れ{目|め}→垂れ目：32994_tareme⟧: downturned eyes (outer corners drooping; looks gentle)
- ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ / ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧: double / single eyelids
